activities.title: Travel to Red Fort
activities.description: Take the Delhi Metro (Yellow Line) from your hotel to Chandni Chowk station; walk to Red Fort entrance.

activities.title: Red Fort Exploration
activities.description: Guided entry to Red Fort (entry fee INR 500 per adult). Explore the historic Mughal architecture, Diwan-i-Aam, and the museum.

activities.title: Snack Break at Chandni Chowk
activities.description: Enjoy a quick street‑food snack (e.g., jalebi or samosa) – approx. INR 100 per person.

activities.title: Travel to Lunch at Karim’s
activities.description: Walk or take an auto‑rickshaw to Karim’s near Jama Masjid for a classic Mughlai lunch.

activities.title: Lunch at Karim’s
activities.description: Traditional dishes such as mutton korma, chicken jahangiri, and naan. Estimated cost INR 400 per person.

activities.title: Travel to Qutub Minar
activities.description: Take the Metro (Yellow to Violet line) to Qutub Minar station.

activities.title: Qutub Minar Complex
activities.description: Entry to Qutub Minar and surrounding monuments (entry fee INR 600 per adult). Explore the tallest brick minaret, Iron Pillar, and historic ruins.

activities.title: Travel to India Gate
activities.description: Short auto‑rickshaw ride to India Gate for a quick photo stop (free).

activities.title: Relax at India Gate
activities.description: Stroll around the memorial, enjoy the evening ambience, and take photos.

activities.title: Return to Hotel
activities.description: Metro ride back to your accommodation.
